notes.title: v0.32 build:30.03.2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Implemented a help mechanism to enhance aiming for projectile-based attacks, benefiting both players and enemies
[*] Added blessing window
[*] Different design approach for mastery trees
[*] Added collectible shards:
[list]
[*] Blood Shard: Heals a percentage of maximum health
[*] Reroll Shard: Can be used in the blessing window to initiate a reroll
[*] Experience Shard: Grants experience points
[*] Mastery Shard: Unlocks mastery levels or provides powerful blessings
[/list]
[*] Aded new attributes:
[list]
[*] Collect Range : adjusts the range for shard collection
[*] Evasion: probability of evading an attack
[*] Accuracy: probability of bypassing the target's evasion
[*] Armor: reduces the amount of physical damage taken
[*] Magic Resistance: reduces the amount of magical damage taken
[*] Cooldown Reduction: modifies cooldown of active abilities
[*] Blood Shard Effectiveness: increase the healing amount of blood shards
[*] Status Resistance: reduces the duration of negative status effects
[*] Experience Multiplier: boosts the amount of experience gained from experience shards
[/list]
[*] Mage and archer is unselectable for now
[*] Added many new skills which can be obtained through mastery window and blessing window
[*] Implemented mobility abilities for each class; players can activate them by pressing the designated input button
[*] Minor improvements for character selection screen
[*] Shard inventory view + health text
[*] Added Skeleton Shaman: A squishy enemy with high magical damage output
[*] Gameplay Rebalance:
[list]
[*] Reduced movement speed for all enemies significantly.
[*] Skeleton melee: Now reduces the armor of the target with attacks instead of slowing them.
[*] Skeleton ranged: Attacks now slow targets instead of paralyzing them.
[*] Skeleton giant: Now possesses boss properties and will appear after reaching a certain kill count threshold.
[/list]
[/list]
